subject: Next steps: NovoCorp evaluation — rollout readiness & credentialing
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novocorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novocorp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 18:15:00 +0100
Subject: Post-call recap + preliminary rollout/readiness checklist

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get your evaluation environment stood up this week: 

Summary of intent
- Objective: 2-week evaluation to validate throughput/latency on your sample logs and measure semantic-search recall for product support queries.
- Primary success criteria (proposed):
  1) 95th percentile latency under 350ms for single-turn generation at 512 tokens
  2) End-to-end retrieval+ranking MAP > 0.68 on your 500-sample eval set
  3) No data exfiltration — all logs retained for 30 days with audit trail

Immediate asks from NovoCorp to proceed
1) Confirm the list of source IPs we'll allow (we'll submit an allowlist request to infra once you confirm CIDR ranges).
2) Confirm SSO domain and whether SAML or SCIM provisioning is preferred (we recommend SAML for roadmap simplicity).
3) Approve short-lived API key access for evaluation (30-day temporary key) and non-production dataset marker.

What Redwood will deliver
- Temporary API key scoped to evaluation model + rate limits (to be provided in a secure link).
- Starter configuration: default batching profile for low-latency, optional KV cache enabled for prefixes.
- A short runbook with success metrics and example CURL/SDK calls.
- Kickoff session with engineering (30–45 min) to run first queries together — propose Thu 2026-07-15 or Fri 2026-07-16.

Attachments: novocorp-eval-scope-v1.pdf (evaluation scope + test dataset notes), mou-novocorp-signature-stub.pdf (MOU draft for internal review).

If that all looks good, reply with: 1) IP ranges, 2) SSO preference + admin email, 3) whether you want the kickoff on 7/15 or 7/16. We'll loop in infra and security immediately after.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novocorp.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novocorp.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:32:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + preliminary rollout/readiness checklist

Thanks Jasmine — useful summary. Quick answers and a minor tweak to the success criteria below.

IP ranges
- Our egress will come from two CIDR blocks: 34.89.120.0/24 and 34.89.121.0/24. Please confirm if we should provide a single IP per cluster or the full /24.

SSO
- We prefer SAML-based SSO. Admin contact: priya.shah@novocorp.com.

API key
- Yes to a 30-day temp key. Can you confirm whether the key can be scoped by project and restricted to non-production endpoints? We need role separation between our evaluation and production teams.

Success criteria adjustment
- For the retrieval+ranking target, can we set a secondary checkpoint at >0.64 in case model mismatch arises during small-sample tuning? We want to avoid false negatives.

Kickoff
- 15 Jul works better for our team (morning CET preferred).

Also: is there an expected template for the security attestation we should complete? If so, please send — security will want to sign off before keys are issued.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of ML Platforms, NovoCorp
liam.oconnor@novocorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: internal - NovoCorp eval tasks (API key / IPs / SSO)

All — quick internal assignment before I reply to Liam / Priya: 

- Ben: can you generate a 30-day scoped API key for NovoCorp (project: nc-eval-2026) and prepare it for secure transfer (DocuSign link or Vault link)? Mark it non-prod and rate-limited to 200r/s burst 500.
- Aditya: please file an allowlist request with infra for 34.89.120.0/24 and 34.89.121.0/24 and confirm whether we need per-node IPs. Add security tag: NOVO-EVAL-2026.
- Jasmine: I'll draft the SAML invite steps and prepare the security attestation template (light-touch questionnaire) and attach to outbound email. Also I'll schedule the kickoff for 2026-07-15 09:30 CET and send a calendar invite.

Attachments: internal-notes-novocorp.txt (planning notes)

Ping me if anything blocks — Ben/Aditya please flag ETA on your tasks.

-marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novocorp.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@novocorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2026 16:42:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + preliminary rollout/readiness checklist

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks — confirming next steps and timings from our side: 

1) API key: Ben will provision the 30-day scoped key and we will deliver it via Vault link by 2026-07-14 EOD (expected). Key will be project-scoped (nc-eval-2026) and restricted to non-production endpoints.
2) IP allowlist: Aditya has submitted NOVO-EVAL-2026 to infra. We asked for the /24 ranges you provided; infra will advise if per-node IPs required — ETA 7/14.
3) SSO: Marissa will send the SAML invite and a short setup doc. We will also attach a light security attestation for your security team to sign.
4) Kickoff: Scheduled for 2026-07-15 09:30 CET — calendar invite sent.

Temporary adjustment to success criteria: we can accept the two-tier checkpoint on MAP (>0.64 soft checkpoint, >0.68 target) as you recommended.

Security attestation and the evaluation scope are attached. We'll hold keys until attestation is returned signed (standard process). If your security team needs additional artifacts (SOC2 pointers, audit-log sample), let us know and we'll prioritize.

Attachments: novocorp-eval-scope-v1.pdf, mou-novocorp-signature-stub.pdf, security-attestation-template.docx

Looking forward to kickoff tomorrow.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
